_comment: Files that tools/strip-source.mjs minifies in place before you publish.
This repo publishes the frontend only; the Express backend, Flask ECG service
and mesh simulation are not part of the deployed tree.
Excluded: tools/** (the strip tool must stay runnable) and the config files
(package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, Tailwind/PostCSS) so the project
still builds and deploys like a normal repo.
